reviews.t: If mobile I recommend two 25 foot
reviews.x: The tube worked fine, but if you walk around its very difficult to keep it from getting twisted and kinked.  I have found that two 25 foot hoses connected by a swivel connector are much more effective.

I bought 2 of these, and both were kinked beyond use straight out of the bag.  One I was able to salvage, somewhat, but it still limits the flow to 4LPM or less, the other had so many kinks it was just trash.  Both were very stiff.
At first the connections seemed a little large for their purpose, but turned out they fitted well with devices to which they attached. High-quality at good price made this a wise purchase for us.

reviews.t: Good hose unless you have cats
reviews.x: This is a decent quality hose that stands up well to normal use going around the house for a constant oxygen wearer. I will say that if you have cats that like to paw at things that move or chew, they do fall victim to that pretty hardcore and will need replacing. And then from the EMT point of view, there's always the fact that when you filter oxygen down 50ft of hose, you're not getting the high-quality oxygen you're looking for, nor are you getting the pressure you have your concentrator set
Great tubing, does not kink like others do. Definitely recommend this tubing.

I like to change out my hose often - I can get free ones from my medical provider but the quality of this one is much better - fewer tangles and fewer problems and that's a good thing. I'll keep buying these.
O.K., This is going to be short & Sweet. The O2 Hose arrived on time & replaced my old one without any problems. I would recommend this hose to anyone on O2.

reviews.t: American Bantex Hose Does It's Job
reviews.x: Product was wrapped and coiled neatly. Had no problems with hooking it up. I will continue to use this style of tubing due to ease in use and availability.
Seems to be a somewhat softer material than the one I received from my o2 supplier.  Does not kink or tangle nearly as much.
It works as it should. It did seem a little flimsy, like it wasn't quite the thickness of the tubing I replaced.

I just reviewed the 25 foot hose, Same good quality. We have a long run, needing a minimum 50 foot of tubing. The ligheter ones kink too easily, and cut off the flow of oxygen, causing a great deal of stress for my wife. This brand is not so bad, and since using, have not had any tight kinks in the hose. I can easily recommend this product. I have re-ordered just to keep a spare on hand, although in the future, we will get 2 25 foot tubing with a swivel to join them to help minimize twisting and

Having been on oxygen 24/7 for 5 years now, I have always had difficulty with the tubing kinking. This product said it did not kink so I bought it. Sadly, it does kink, not as bad as the other, but you realy must keep a close eye on it.

reviews.t: This is much better at reducing the tangles
reviews.x: As mentioned, our provider only offers the green tubing now.  This is much better at reducing the tangles.

This is to replace the junk tubing my O2 company provides to me.  Their tubing is thin, kinks and cracks after a few months, cutting off O2 delivery.  I was hoping to find tubing that lasted longer and didn't kink.  This tubing kinked and coiled after only 2 weeks of use.  I don't know if there is a better product of this type available, I'll keep searching.  But this tubing isn't patient friendly and I'll not reorder.

This tubing is very poor quality. It is yellowish I color and looks aged. It is also thin walled and kinks very easily, so much so that I had to discard it. Would not recommend unless you like throwing money away.
I like this item was exactly as described the only problem was I had was is still a little excessive in the tangled up area. I truly believe is more my fault the air hose
glad I found this non-kink oxygen tubing- it's great
It kinks and it crushable. Very disappointed
Terrible.  Curls up after about 2 hours use

reviews.t: Works fine if you don't need a lot of mobility
reviews.x: This tubing, as other reviewers have noted, is a little stiff and inflexible instead of being more soft and pliable like more expensive tubing. However, it works just fine for my purpose.  I have to bleed 2 LPM into my CPAP machine from an O2 concentrator. To minimize the noise, the concentrator sits in the hallway outside the bedroom door with the tubing coming under door. I use 3M "Command strip" hooks to guide the tubing around the room to the CPAP machine and keep it off the floor. I don't n

People who depend on portable oxygen will know how difficult it can be to find tubing which does not "kink"--tangling in on itself, blocking the air-flow, and really becoming a nuisance.  The manufacturers of this product describe it as "non-kink" and they tell the truth.  It is refreshing to find tubing which behaves itself, even when extended to the maximum medically recommended length of 50'.  When, after a while, it does begin to tangle, it's time to turn to new tubing anyway.  I was skeptic

reviews.t: Won't get this again if I don't have to
reviews.x: Too narrow a gauge for starters, crushes enough to obliterate flow with the least pressure, and kinks and knots up like crazy even though I'm using swivel connectors. Starts to stiffen up at as high as 60 degrees F and I hate to think what it will be like when it's exposed to even colder temps come Fall and Winter months. If you have the choice to not buy this, don't.

I have brought this item before, this order is a different type and the plastic odor makes the tubing unusable, I will keep the one I opened but I am sending the other 2 back.  It sucks that you think you are getting the same product when you do a reorder but I guess that's not the case. I will not be buying this item again.

its not that the tubbing does not work it does. but i did not want green.and no wherewas it listed that it might come in that color.for if it did i would not of ordered it. does any oneeven wonder how this effects a person who is on oxygen?i think not.

Product ordered was American Bantex by Roscoe Medical. Product shipped was Medline. I like American Bantex hoses, DONT LIKE MEDLINE FAT KINKY AND ALWAYS MEASURE SHORT OF ADVERTISED.  Won’t be ordering from NECommerce ever again

claims.text: Many reviewers report the tubing kinks or tangles, though some find it kinks less than other brands.
Several reviewers praise the overall quality and value, calling it a good or wise purchase.
Some reviewers describe the tubing as thin, flimsy, stiff, or poor quality.
A few reviewers note it is softer or reduces tangles compared to tubing from their oxygen provider.
Some reviewers mention the tubing is vulnerable to damage from pets such as cats.
